name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.buttonsystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: Demonstrates ButtonPlus in a UGUI scene: long-click modes (Once/Continuous/PressedAndReleased) with triggerTime/intervalTime, the Scale press-transition, and onClick/onLongClickPressed/onLongClickReleased wiring.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the ButtonSystem: ButtonPlus long-click modes, scale transition, event wiring, and the InputField placeholder remover. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
